attributes.title: MNRS 51st Annual Research Conference
attributes.venue: Amway Grand Plaza by Hilton & DeVos Place Convention Center
attributes.summary:
The Midwest Nursing Research Society holds its 51st Annual Research Conference from March 31 to April 3, 2027, at the Amway Grand Plaza by Hilton and DeVos Place Convention Center in Grand Rapids, Michigan. The theme is "Bridging Healthcare Access through Nursing Scholarship, Partnership, Policy, and Practice." Nurse researchers, faculty, PhD and DNP students and clinical nurse scientists from the Midwest make up most of the audience.

Registration is open. Cancellations before February 12, 2027, are refunded minus a $50 service fee, and registrations can be transferred to a colleague. Registered attendees can book the Amway Grand Plaza at $204 per night plus taxes until February 26, 2027. Late-breaking abstracts open December 8, 2026. Fee amounts and contact hours were not shown in text on the conference page when we checked.
